sloka: पुच्छेन च प्रदीप्तेन तां पुरीं साट्टगोपुराम् ।दहाम्यहमसम्भ्रान्तो युगान्ताग्निरिव प्रजाः ।। ५.५८.१५५ ।।।।
transliteration: pucchena ca pradīptena tāṁ purīṁ sāṭṭagopurām ।dahāmyahamasambhrānto yugāntāgniriva prajāḥ ।। 5.58.155 ।।।।

translations.english: "Then I leaped to the entrance gate of the city without being perplexed. With my burning tail I set fire to the boundaries and towering mansions which looked like the world at the end of dissolution.
